differences.native: MySQL computes seconds with TIMESTAMPDIFF and rounds seconds/60 upward with CEIL.
differences.app: SQLite subtracts Unix seconds obtained with strftime('%s') and uses integer (seconds + 59) / 60.
differences.rationale: SQLite does not implement TIMESTAMPDIFF. The per-log upward rounding, left join, employee grouping, zero-log handling, required-minute comparison, and output are identical.
